blind.description: A stylized wooden roof hatch or cellar trapdoor propped open. It features a square wooden collar frame reinforced with dark metal corner brackets, an open wooden planked lid held upright by an angled metal support rod and heavy metal hinges, an iron pull ring handle mounted at the top lip, and a wooden ladder descending into a dark interior void opening.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square wooden frame surrounding a dark interior opening with the top rung of a wooden ladder visible, and the open rectangular lid extending outward on its hinges with its metal support strut and pull ring clearly visible.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: black interior void inside the hatch opening
blind.height_vs_figure: With the lid open it stands roughly 3 feet tall (about half the height of the figure), and the base frame is approximately 3.5 feet by 3.5 feet square.
